notes.intro: Friday October 30: first hands-on verdicts on Apple's touchscreen MacBook Pro, Pika's open-weights H3 Flex with five audio stems, ElevenLabs SFX v3, Claude Code mods, Fremantle's AI micro-drama recut of Neighbours, hybrid live-action/AI feature Beta Builder starting its shoot, Korea's 90-minute AI feature Steelay, SAG-AFTRA's AI dubbing consent deal, and OpenAI's rewritten Model Spec.

title: AI News, Monday November 2

Runway lets you swap the actor in a shot while keeping the performance, Kling four point oh shows up everywhere at once, VEED launches lip-synced dubbing as an API, Tencent open-sources a small editing agent that cuts long-form video, and a new image-to-video model goes for half a cent a second.
